svg.title: Where USDe was held, January 31, 2026 to May 31, 2026
svg.desc: Stacked areas of USDe's total supply on Ethereum at the end of each day from January 31, 2026 to May 31, 2026, in billions of USDe, split into the USDe held by sUSDe, the USDe in sUSDe's cooldown silo and the USDe outside both. sUSDe's cooldown was cut from seven days to one on March 16, 2026. At the end of April 18, 2026, the day of the rsETH exploit, supply was 5.83 billion, of which sUSDe held 3.53 billion. At the end of April 27, 2026 it was 3.75 billion, of which sUSDe held 2.16 billion. The silo peaked at 0.43 billion on April 20, 2026. On May 31, 2026 supply was 4.51 billion, of which sUSDe held 1.79 billion.
svg.text: USDe's supply fell 35.61% in the nine days after the rsETH exploit
USDe's total supply on Ethereum at the end of each UTC day, January 31 to May 31, 2026, in billions, by where it was held

svg.text: Reads at the last block of each UTC day on two archive RPCs that gave identical answers, with USDe counted as one dollar.
The silo holds the USDe of unstaked sUSDe until its cooldown ends. Held by sUSDe includes rewards not yet vested.
Outside sUSDe is the rest of the supply on Ethereum, including the USDe locked there to back USDe on other chains.
